preconditions.description: The size of the input does not exceed 1048576 bytes.

preconditions.expression: any(c in stdin for c in range(32, 128))
preconditions.description: The input contains at least one character other than a newline.

preconditions.expression: all(c in range(32, 128) or c in (10, 13) for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input have codes from 32 to 127 or are newline characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(line if line.startswith('#') else line.replace(' ', '') for line in stdin.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The output contains the spell with spaces removed from non-amplifying lines and amplifying lines preserved.
Each output line is followed by a newline.
